verdict.rationale: ImageMagick ships C, C++, Python, .NET and Node.js API bindings, so this axis applies, but the evidence pack never documents API versioning guarantees or a deprecation policy. The version number (7.1.1-16) and the general 'migration guidelines when porting commands' are adjacent material, not a stated policy on versioned APIs or deprecation timelines, so they earn no credit. No OpenAPI or similar versioned API spec was found either.
